title: Public /api/stats still returns operational counts

required_action: After the business confirms the counts are not a required disclosure, stop returning them from the public API and remove the live production footer cards on the next approved cutover.

title: Upload token Open Graph and canonical inherit the homepage
evidence: app/upload/[token]/page.js sets title Upload documents and robots noindex,nofollow, and does not set a canonical or Open Graph title. Phase 7B crawl of /upload/example-token showed homepage Open Graph, description, and canonical, with no H1 for an unrecognised token. The path is robots Disallow /upload and out of the sitemap.
required_action: Give the disabled upload route its own noindex canonical and Open Graph title, or accept the residual because the route is disallowed and noindex.

title: Phase 7E mobile Contact screenshot timeout
evidence: The failed script waited for a heading named Latest immigration news, which is not the homepage heading, and clicked the tab before hydration using the visible uppercase label. A later hydrated click opened /contact and saved tab-contact-390.png (69446 bytes). End-to-end visual regression passed at 390, 768, and 1440.
